partnershipPlan: Two second-year representatives and two near-peer tutors review the information sheet and the timetable plan.
socialListening: No social media listening; the school's module feedback comments from 2024 to 2026 are read for mentions of near-peer sessions.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I asked the final-years things I would never ask a consultant.
items.implication: Record student confidence as context, not as the effect measure.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: They teach what gets you through the station, not always what finds the murmur.
items.implication: Include tutor calibration and track technique errors.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I loved teaching, but not six weeks before my own finals.
items.implication: Schedule near-peer sessions early and measure tutor time before finals.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If my group gets fewer consultants, I want to know it is not making my exam harder.
items.implication: Explain the allocation and publish pass rates by arm to students.

summary: Four composite voices on approachability, technique, tutor workload and fairness.
